verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing documents event-driven automation: transaction rules that automatically approve or decline authorizations, relayed authorisation webhooks, and event webhooks. None of this is a user-configurable recurring schedule for jobs or workflows. Scheduling is a fair question for a fintech platform, so the axis applies, but the pack has no evidence of it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
